APPROVE. The checks moved verbatim into `ConvictedEntryKey`, and each old `continue` becomes `return null`, which the caller turns into the same `continue`, so behaviour is unchanged. The loop's branching and the `&&`/`||` chains no longer count toward `ScanLines`, which brings it under 15 (I estimated this, I did not run a complexity tool).

I could not see the unchanged lines between the two hunks, so I'm assuming they only use `key` and `i`. If they use `entry`, the build would break.
